arguments.text: Plan (1 min): 8 km, 6.4 legs of 1250 m. CP boat 130 W / pod 194 W, may be 10-25% off. Hard start; settle near CP by min 2-3, then pace so reserve reaches ~0 at finish. Leg 1 current against (push_along -0.12). Watch pod vs boat reserve for disagreement (current/drag/fouled rudder). Finish sprint last ~400-600 m.

arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus course current estimate; strongly negative = extra drag (weed on rudder, damage) not current

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power explains, beyond current: check rudder/drag
pace well faster than sustainable after the start
700 m to go: plan the finish

text: no cue: hard start is expected and should settle; set watches for extra drag, over-pacing after 3 min, and the finish zone

arguments.text: Ease slightly now. Settle at one fifty six pace.

3.7 min: still hot (154 W vs CP 130, reserve boat 36% / pod 45%). Cued ease to 156 s/500 ground (sustainable water ~155.6; current small, flips each leg). Check at next wake that power drops to ~130-135 W and reserve stabilises; if reserve keeps falling with power near CP, CP may be overstated.

text: cued ease to 156 s/500: power 154 W well above CP 130 W, reserve would empty in about 700 m

arguments.text: Ease now, breathe. Hold one fifty seven, long race left.

6.7 min: first ease cue (156) only partly followed: power 153->141 W, display 151.5. Reserve boat 11% / pod 13%, paddler says 10/10 really hurting. Cued ease to 157 ground. Next: confirm power at or below ~132 W and reserve stops falling. Course current small (leg1 against ~-0.06, leg2 ~+0.02).

arguments.condition: elapsed_s > 540 and remaining_m > 1200 and power_w < 120 and w_bal_pod_frac > 0.2
arguments.message: power well under CP with some reserve back: may be too easy

text: cued ease to 157 s/500: reserve near empty (11-13%), paddler at 10/10; added watches for too easy and empty reserve

arguments.text: You are on empty. Ease to one fifty five, recover.

8.3 min: pod reserve 3%, boat 0%, fade -3.4% at same rate. Second ease cue partly followed (shaft 225->201 W, boat still ~138 W). Cued ease to 155 ground (current now helps ~+0.1 on leg 2, so that is ~160 water, below CP, to refill). CP 130/194 looks about right so far (fading while just above it). After turn at ~2500 m current turns against: ground pace target must loosen there (~158-160).

text: cued ease to 155 s/500 ground: reserve empty and fading, needs a spell under critical power to avoid blowing up

arguments.text: Good. Settle at one fifty nine, through the turn and beyond.

11.3 min: eased to CP (boat 129 W, shaft 192 W); reserve ~4% and refilling slowly. Shaft-to-boat ratio steady ~0.67 (no drag problem). Course current ~0.07 m/s: helps on southbound legs 2,4,6, against on northbound legs 3,5,7. At CP: ground pace ~153 on helping legs, ~159 on against legs. Cued hold 159 ground before turn at 2500 m (slight recovery now, CP after turn). Plan: hold CP to ~600 m left, then finish with the refilled reserve.

arguments.condition: elapsed_s > 600 and remaining_m > 900 and shaft_power_w > 206 and w_bal_pod_frac < 0.12
arguments.message: shaft power above CP with reserve nearly empty

text: cued hold at 159 s/500 ground through the turn: at critical power now with an empty reserve; next leg is into the current

arguments.text: 11.7 min: paddler said I am cooked, cannot hold this (24 s after the hold-159 cue, which is already an easing on this helping leg). Holding ~128 W boat / 189 shaft at CP. If power keeps sinking below ~120 W or fade worsens at CP, the true CP may be lower than 130: consider set_critical_power down (~115-120) after evidence.

text: no cue: gate closed for 40 s and the hold-159 cue just given already eases this leg; noted the paddler report

arguments.text: Ease a touch. One fifty nine into the current.

14.7 min, leg 3 (against current ~-0.07): reserve had refilled to ~12% at 117-127 W (so CP ~130 is plausible), now paddler drifted up to 140 W / 209 shaft (display 155.7, faster than the 159 target) and reserve back to 7%. Cued ease 159 ground. Paddler repeatedly runs hotter than cued: expect to re-cue each leg. Turn at ~3750 m: then helping leg, CP ground ~153.

text: cued ease to 159 s/500 ground: power crept back above critical power with the reserve near empty

arguments.message: turned onto a southbound (current helping) leg: retarget ground pace ~154
turned onto a northbound (current against) leg: retarget ground pace ~159

arguments.text: 16.2 min: on the 159 target (display 158.7), boat 132 W ~CP, shaft 202 (pod reserve 3%, boat 7%). Shaft/boat ratio steady ~1.5 all race, so pod and boat agree. Added turn watches (south = helping leg: aim ~154 ground, slightly under CP; north = against: ~159). Remaining ~4800 m; hold CP, finish push from ~600 m.

text: no cue: paddler is on the 159 target at about critical power; added turn watches to retarget pace each leg

arguments.text: Stay smooth, one sixty. Save it for the finish.

text: cued ease to 160 s/500: paddler drifting above critical power (136 W) with pod reserve at 2%; the turn-north alert was the watch starting on an already-northbound leg
